Accumedix serves the medical device industry exclusively, working with customers ranging from individual inventors to Fortune 1000 companies.

Accumedix differentiates itself by integrating regulatory and quality expertise directly into manufacturing, offering a quality system by subscription that aims to reduce compliance lead times from months to weeks, and by accepting assembly and packaging orders of any volume without minimum requirements.

Known for: Quality management system by subscription with FDA/European management representation; Clean room and white room manufacturing for clinical trial through full production; Assembly and packaging with no minimum volume requirements; Over 90 years of combined medical device quality and regulatory experience on staff; ASQ Certified Quality Engineer and Quality Auditor on site
